name: io.github.legumeinfo/legumista
title: Legumista
description: Legume genomics over MCP: the LIS Data Store catalog, InterMine queries, scholarly search, NCBI/EDirect, and pysam tools.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server (stdio) via `uvx legumista mcp`. Append '--allow-write' to permit write operations, and '--allow-report' (with a GitHub App configured) to serve report_data_issue.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_CONTACT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your address, sent as the mailto to OpenAlex, Crossref and Unpaywall so requests use their polite pools. Recommended: paper_search, openalex_by_doi, lis_lineage and verify_ids all query Crossref.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_CATALOG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where to download the LIS catalog from on startup. Defaults to the published datastore-metadata release asset.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the downloaded catalog is cached. Defaults to ~/.cache/legumista. A warm cache is what the server falls back to when the catalog host is unreachable.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_CATALOG_POLL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between background catalog checks (conditional GET, so an unchanged catalog costs a 304). Default 86400; 0 disables.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret enabling POST /catalog/refresh, authenticated with GitHub's X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC scheme. Unset, the route is not registered at all. HTTP transport only.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory the genomics tools may read local files from (they are sandboxed to it). Defaults to the working directory; also settable with `legumista mcp -C DIR`.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_PYSAM_ALLOWED_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated http(s) URL-prefix allowlist for the genomics tools; when unset, any public host is allowed (private/loopback are always blocked).

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_CATALOG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Pin the server to a local catalog.json instead of downloading one: nothing is fetched and polling is off.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_DEPLOYMENT
environmentVariables.description: 'public' advertises every tool as read-only so a public host's users are not prompted; anything else (the default) keeps the hints honest, so local users are asked before a tool writes or files an issue.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_GITHUB_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: The GitHub App report_data_issue files issues as (with --allow-report). Give it only Issues read & write, installed only on the target repository. Unset, the tool is not served.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_GITHUB_APP_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the GitHub App's private key (PEM). The server signs short-lived tokens with it; the key never leaves the server.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional: the App's installation ID. Unset, it is looked up from the target repository.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_REPORT_REPOS
environmentVariables.description: Where report_data_issue files, as service=owner/repo#label pairs. Defaults to datastore=matthewwiese/datastore-metadata#datastore-issue,mine=matthewwiese/datastore-metadata#mine-issue.
